Signature
No display size at all: the largest text is 40 px, centred in an empty dark field, with four 12 px corner labels holding the frame. Rank comes from position and silence.
Use when
Small hotels, private members clubs, fragrance, a launch teaser where restraint is the message.
Turns into slop when
On a landing page that needs to sell or explain (it reads as empty), with a blurred photo behind it, or when the corners hold filler like "Est. 2024" without a reason.
